```{r} 
#| label: set-up
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(ipdw)
library(knitr)

## Load packages and functions from setup script
source(here::here("3-scripts", "1-functions.r"))

trg_crs <- "EPSG:6440" # NAD 83 Florida State Plane North 

data_dir <- here::here("2-data","processed")
rast_dir <- here::here("2-data","rasters")
table_dir <- here::here("4-tables-and-figures", "tables")
hsm_dir <- here::here("2-data", "hsm")
map_dir <- here::here("4-tables-and-figures", "maps")

study_area <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "study_area.rds")) %>%
  st_transform(trg_crs)

study_extent <- study_area %>%
  st_bbox() %>%
  st_as_sfc() %>%
  st_buffer(1000)

mask <- rast(file.path(rast_dir, "complete_mask.tif")) 

# Load Suitability 

sdm <- rast(file.path(rast_dir, "maxent_suitability.tif")) 
hsi <- rast(file.path(hsm_dir, "normalized_suitability.tif"))

sdm <- project(sdm, mask)
hsi <- project(hsi, mask)

# 2. Align extent, resolution, and row/column counts to shared_mask
sdm_aligned <- resample(sdm, mask, method = "bilinear")
hsi_aligned <- resample(hsi, mask, method = "bilinear")

# 3. Mask using the aligned rasters
hsi_compare <- mask(hsi_aligned, mask)
maxent_compare <- mask(sdm_aligned, mask)
```

# 1. Classify rasters into 5 comparable classes

```{r}
# Align the continuous HSI raster to the MaxEnt grid.

# Fixed equal-interval boundaries.
class_breaks <- c(0, 0.20, 0.40, 0.60, 0.80, 1)

# Columns: lower boundary, upper boundary, class number.
rcl <- cbind(
  head(class_breaks, -1),
  tail(class_breaks, -1),
  1:5
)

hsi_class <- terra::classify(
  hsi_compare,
  rcl,
  right = FALSE,
  include.lowest = TRUE,
  others = NA
)

maxent_class <- terra::classify(
  maxent_compare,
  rcl,
  right = FALSE,
  include.lowest = TRUE,
  others = NA
)

# Cross-tabulation: rows are HSI classes, columns are MaxEnt classes.
class_pair <- c(hsi_class, maxent_class)
names(class_pair) <- c("HSI", "MaxEnt")

agreement_table <- crosstab(class_pair)
agreement_table

# Calculate agreement percentages and continuous rank correlation.
comparison <- data.frame(
  exact_agreement_pct = 100 * global(
    hsi_class == maxent_class, "mean", na.rm = TRUE
  )[1, 1],

  within_one_class_pct = 100 * global(
    abs(hsi_class - maxent_class) <= 1, "mean", na.rm = TRUE
  )[1, 1],

  spearman_rho = cor(
    values(hsi_compare, mat = FALSE),
    values(maxent_compare, mat = FALSE),
    method = "spearman",
    use = "complete.obs"
  )
)

comparison

subtract <- hsi_class - maxent_class

# Add descriptive class labels.
class_key <- data.frame(
  ID = 1:5,
  suitability = c(
    "Low", "Intermediate-low", "Intermediate",
    "Intermediate-high", "High"
  )
)

levels(hsi_class) <- class_key
levels(maxent_class) <- class_key

# Check the number of cells assigned to each class.
freq(hsi_class)
freq(maxent_class)



```

```{r}
#| label: plot-maxent-map

my_bbox <- sf::st_bbox(
  c(
    xmin = terra::xmin(mask),
    ymin = terra::ymin(mask),
    xmax = terra::xmax(mask),
    ymax = terra::ymax(mask)
  ),
  crs = sf::st_crs(terra::crs(mask))
)

maxent_class <- as.factor(maxent_class)

levels(maxent_class) <- data.frame(
  ID = 1:5,
  suitability = c(
    "Low", "Intermediate-low", "Intermediate",
    "Intermediate-high", "High"
  )
)

me_map <-
  tmap::tm_basemap("Esri.WorldGrayCanvas") +
  tmap::tm_shape(maxent_class, bbox = my_bbox) +
  tmap::tm_raster(
    col_alpha = 0.85,
    col.scale = tm_scale_categorical(
        values = "brewer.rd_yl_gn",
        value.na = "transparent",
        levels.drop = FALSE
      ),
    col.legend = tm_legend(
      title = "Modeled Suitability",
      title.fontface = 2,
      position = tm_pos_out("center", "bottom", pos.h = "CENTER"),
      orientation = "landscape",
      na.show = FALSE,
      show = TRUE
    )
  ) +
  # tmap::tm_shape(pb[pb$pb == 1L, ]) +
  # tmap::tm_dots(
  #   fill = "black",
  #   col = "black",
  #   size = 0.05
  # ) +
  # tmap::tm_layout(
  #   frame = TRUE,
  #   inner.margins = c(0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
  # ) +
  tmap::tm_title(
    "C. virginica Habitat Suitability (MaxEnt)",
    fontface = 2,
    position = tm_pos_out("center", "top", pos.h = "left", pos.v = "BOTTOM")
  ) +
  tmap::tm_compass(type = "8star", size = 3)

me_map

tmap_save(me_map, file.path(map_dir, "maxent_suitability.png"))
```

```{r}
#| label: map-comparison

my_bbox <- sf::st_bbox(
  c(
    xmin = terra::xmin(mask),
    ymin = terra::ymin(mask),
    xmax = terra::xmax(mask),
    ymax = terra::ymax(mask)
  ),
  crs = sf::st_crs(terra::crs(mask))
)

sub_cont <- hsi - sdm

favor_map <-
  tmap::tm_basemap("Esri.WorldGrayCanvas") +
  tmap::tm_shape(subtract, bbox = my_bbox) +
  tmap::tm_raster(
    col_alpha = 0.85,
    col.scale = tm_scale_continuous(
      values = "brewer.spectral",
      limits = c(-4, 4),
      midpoint = 0,
      ticks = c(-4, 0, 4),
      labels = c("MaxEnt", "Agree", "HSI"),
      value.na = "transparent"
    ),
    col.legend = tm_legend(
      title = "Favorability",
      title.fontface = 2,
      position = tm_pos_out("center", "bottom", pos.h = "CENTER"),
      orientation = "landscape",
      na.show = FALSE,
      show = TRUE,
      item.width = 10
    )
  ) +
  tmap::tm_title(
    "C. virginica Habitat Favorability (Comparison)",
    fontface = 2,
    position = tm_pos_out("center", "top", pos.h = "left", pos.v = "BOTTOM")
  ) +
  tmap::tm_compass(type = "8star", size = 3)

favor_map

tmap_save(favor_map, file.path(map_dir, "model_favorability.png"), overwrite = TRUE)
```
